---
title: "Second Order Approximation CIs for the Binomial and Exponential distributions"
author: '[Francisco Javier Rubio](https://sites.google.com/site/fjavierrubio67/)'
date: "22 February 2019"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
################################################################################################
# Wald CI: Binomial case
################################################################################################

# Example 1
rm(list = ls())

library(numDeriv)

# Data
n <- 10
set.seed(4)
t <- rbinom(n = 1, size = n, prob = 0.3)
theta.hat <- t/n
theta.hat

# Profile likelihood
Rp <- Vectorize(function(theta)  theta^t*(1-theta)^(n-t)/( theta.hat^t*(1-theta.hat)^(n-t) ))

# Lambda function
Lambda <-  Vectorize( function(theta) -2*log(Rp(theta)) )

#----------------------------------------
# Wald approximation function for theta
#-----------------------------------------

hess.theta <-  hessian(Lambda , x = theta.hat)

# Threshold
lev <- 2*qchisq(0.95, df = 1)/hess.theta
lev

W.theta = Vectorize( function(theta) return( (theta-theta.hat)^2 ))
# Visualising the profile likelihood of sigma
curve(W.theta,0,1, n = 1000, lwd =3, col = "blue", cex.axis = 2, cex.lab = 1.5, main =  expression(paste("Wald function of ", theta), ylim = c(0,1)),
      xlab = ~theta, ylab = "Wald")
abline(h = lev, lwd = 2, col = "red")
abline(v = theta.hat, lwd = 2, col = "purple", lty = 2)

# 95% Confidence interval
W.thetaC = Vectorize( function(theta) return(W.theta(theta)-lev))

c(uniroot(W.thetaC,c(0.01,0.4))$root,uniroot(W.thetaC,c(0.4,0.8))$root)

################################################################################################
# Wald: Exponential case
################################################################################################

# Example 1
rm(list = ls())

# Data
set.seed(123)
x <- rexp(n = 10, rate = 1)
x.bar <- mean(x)
n <- length(x)
theta.hat <- x.bar
theta.hat

# Profile likelihood
Rp <- Vectorize(function(theta)  ( exp(-n*x.bar/theta)/theta^n )/( exp(-n*x.bar/theta.hat)/theta.hat^n )  )

# Lambda function
Lambda <-  Vectorize( function(theta) -2*log(Rp(theta)) )

#----------------------------------------
# Wald approximation function for theta
#-----------------------------------------

hess.theta <-  hessian(Lambda , x = theta.hat)

# Threshold
lev <- 2*qchisq(0.95, df = 1)/hess.theta
lev

W.theta = Vectorize( function(theta) return( (theta-theta.hat)^2 ))
# Visualising the profile likelihood of sigma
curve(W.theta,0,1.5, n = 1000, lwd =3, col = "blue", cex.axis = 2, cex.lab = 1.5, main =  expression(paste("Wald function of ", theta), ylim = c(0,1)),
      xlab = ~theta, ylab = "Wald")
abline(h = lev, lwd = 2, col = "red")
abline(v = theta.hat, lwd = 2, col = "purple", lty = 2)

# 95% Confidence interval
W.thetaC = Vectorize( function(theta) return(W.theta(theta)-lev))

c(uniroot(W.thetaC,c(0.1,0.6))$root,uniroot(W.thetaC,c(0.7,1.3))$root)
```
